initial_state_assessment.limits: No serialized warmed TrafficState arrays located in inspected finalized waves; source creates states in memory. State hashes attest equality but cannot reconstruct arrays. Seeds alone omit physical parameters, backend/RNG implementations, dtypes/order, assignment rules, model versions/weights and deterministic inference rules. Sufficient recipe for re-evaluation with selected bundles and pinned code/runtime, not a claim of cross-version bitwise equivalence or exact training restart. Training additionally needs optimizer/algorithm state, segment RNG seeds, worker counts, seed guards/audits and non-restored environment/cache/episode state disclosures.
initial_state_assessment.recipe: 540 physical roads: 18 densities x30 runs, 1000-step all-HDV warmup, one seeded PV assignment, nested AV subsets 90/95/100%, measurement RNG reset for 2000 steps. Five seed fields: scenario_seed, warmup_rng_seed, measurement_rng_seed, assignment_seed, av_selection_seed. Test root 710009, validation root 610003; tie-break root 620000 with family/seed-specific receipts.
